WITH currency_averages AS (
  SELECT
    feecoin,
    AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebtotal,
    AVG((rebrate - feerate) / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_relative_gap
  FROM fees
  GROUP BY feecoin
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rebtotal) AS avg_of_currency_rebates
  FROM currency_averages
)
SELECT
  AVG(c.avg_rebtotal) AS mean_avg_maker_rebate,
  AVG(c.avg_relative_gap) AS mean_avg_relative_gap,
  AVG(c.avg_rebtotal - b.avg_of_currency_rebates) AS mean_excess_over_benchmark
FROM currency_averages AS c
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE b.avg_of_currency_rebates IS NOT NULL
  AND c.avg_rebtotal > b.avg_of_currency_rebates
